sentences.text: On 1.27, the documentation includes a Ceph RBD StorageClass example and lists the internal provisioner as supported for Ceph RBD.
On 1.31, the Ceph RBD provisioner is marked as deprecated but still documented, indicating it can still be created.

citations.quote: FEATURE STATE: Kubernetes v1.28 [deprecated] This internal provisioner of Ceph RBD is deprecated
